'''Lythos VII''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Lythos system/Legends|Lythos system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate sector]]. The seventh [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], Lythos VII was one of four [[Farm/Legends|agricultural]] worlds in the system, the others being [[Lythos VI]], [[Lythos VIII]], and [[Lythos Nine|Lythos IX]]. The Lythos system, and therefore Lythos VII, was located at the crossroads of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and [[Trianii Shunt]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lythos VII was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. ''The Essential Atlas'' placed it in grid square S-3.<ref name="TEA" />
